welcome.title: Welcome to IDLE Arcade!
welcome.description: IDLE Arcade is a room-based idle arcade. Each room is planned to offer a different game. The room navigation shows which rooms are available and which are still locked.

darts.title: Start with Darts
darts.description: Darts is your first available room. In the planned Darts game, you will be able to earn coins. The room is currently a placeholder while gameplay is being developed.

progression.title: Upgrade & Unlock
progression.description: Planned progression will let you use earned coins for upgrades and unlock more rooms as you advance. Upgrades, progression, and room unlocking are still being developed.
